prompt: Vert.x CSRFHandler session aware token regeneration condition
answer:
Vert.x’s session-aware `CSRFHandler` regenerates the token when:

- The session is upgraded (for example, unauthenticated → authenticated or a role change).
- No token exists in the session.
- The existing token has expired according to the configured timeout.

Otherwise, while the same session’s token remains valid, it is reused. ([Vert.x Web documentation](https://vertx.io/docs/4.1.8/vertx-web/java/), [CSRFHandlerImpl](https://github.com/vert-x3/vertx-web/blob/master/vertx-web/src/main/java/io/vertx/ext/web/handler/impl/CSRFHandlerImpl.java))
